title: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Water Treatment Equipment at the Municipal Water Works
summary: Contradictory eligibility clauses detected: turnover must be both >= 50 cr (CL2) and <= 10 cr (CL5). No vendor can satisfy both requirements simultaneously. No network-level flags found for this tender.
reasoning: The Z3 solver proves that clauses CL2 (turnover of at least ₹50 crore) and CL5 (turnover not exceeding ₹10 crore) are mutually exclusive, making it impossible for any vendor to qualify. GFR 2017 Rule 173 (KB-012) states that the bidding document should be self-contained and comprehensive without any ambiguities; contradictory eligibility criteria are the opposite of that. A contradictory set of criteria effectively bars all participation, which may indicate a drafting error or an intent to cancel and re-tender to a preferred party. Recommend manual review of clause origins and amendment history.
recommended_actions: Flag contradictory clauses CL2 and CL5 to the tender-issuing authority for clarification or corrigendum.
Review amendment history to determine if the contradiction was introduced after the original publication.
Check if a re-tender was issued with revised criteria favoring a specific vendor.
disclaimer: Risk indicators only; not a finding of wrongdoing. Recommendation requires human review.
